descriptionChirho: A male person in his youth, typically from adolescence to early adulthood. Used in the NT for the young man at Jesus' tomb (Mark 16:5), the youth who fled naked (Mark 14:51), young men in the early church (Acts 5:10), and in direct address (1 John 2:13-14). The two clusters differ only in grammatical number: S72663 is singular (nominative, accusative, vocative) and S72665 is plural (vocative, nominative). Translations confirm uniform meaning: Spanish 'joven/jóvenes', Hindi युवक/जवानो, Arabic الشاب/شبّان, Korean 청년/젊은이들, Swahili 'kijana/vijana'. Pure number inflection, one lexicographic sense.
